name: switchboard
short: Install addpath cogs' requirements and load/unload cogs in dependency order.
description: Red only installs a cog's info.json requirements through Downloader ([p]cog install), and never reads required_cogs. Switchboard fills both gaps for cogs loaded from [p]addpath or --cog-path directories: it installs their requirements into Downloader's own lib directory, loads and unloads several cogs in required_cogs order, reports whether each cog came from Downloader, addpath, a CLI path, or Red itself, and reloads the cogs it manages after a restart. It needs no other cog and no requirements of its own.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any data or metadata about users.
install_msg: Bot owner only. Start with `[p]switchboard status`, then `[p]switchboard load <cogs>` (or `all`) to install requirements and load cogs in dependency order.
author: Tin Nguyen
